enable_auth.description: Enable NTP authentication using keys (requires keyfile and commandkey).

fallback_sources.description: List of external NTP servers to use as fallback sources when the local reference is unavailable.

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the fallback NTP server.

prefer.description: If true, prefer this server over others (adds 'prefer' keyword to server directive).

enable_rtcsync.description: Enable synchronization of the system RTC to the system clock.

enable_kernel_ptp.description: Enable kernel PTP support for precise PHC (Precision Hardware Clock) synchronization.

ptp_device.description: PTP hardware clock device used as the stratum-0 reference (passed to refclock PHC).
